name: mesh-shadergradient
title: Mesh Shader Gradient
blurb: Animated shader gradient using ShaderGradient library.
description: WebGL gradient animation powered by ShaderGradient library. Renders a full-screen canvas with customizable animated gradient patterns.
use_when: A polished, animated gradient background using pre-built ShaderGradient effects.
avoid_when: Low-end devices or environments without WebGL support. Requires ShaderGradient library dependency.
a11y: Canvas overlay with pointer-events-none; focus and keyboard behaviour come from overlaid content.
